授業概要
昨今、ヒトと動物の間で起こっている問題は深刻化し、かつ枚挙にいとまがない。例えば、イノシシやニホンジカなどとの間でおこっている野生鳥獣問題や、肉食とビーガンの問題、コンパニオンアニマルの問題などである。これらの問題を考えることは、保護や保全を含めた、動物との良好な関係を構築、維持することを目指すだけではなく、ヒトという生き物を深く知ることにもつながる。本講義では、様々なヒトと動物の問題をとりあげ、その解決の方向性とヒトについて探求していきたい。
These days, the problems between humans and animals are growing and endless. For example, the problems of wildlife with wild boars and sika deer, the problems of carnivory and vegans, and the problems of companion animals. Thinking about these issues not only aims to build and maintain good relationships with animals, including conservation and protection, but also leads to a deeper understanding of human. In this lecture, I will take up various human and animal problems and explore the direction of the solution and the human.

全体の教育目標
Through classroom learning and practical training, students become aware of problems related to human-animal relationships, and can think about and act on solutions and mitigations of these problems from multiple perspectives.
個別の教育目標
When it comes to issues related to human-animal relationships, you will be able to recognize how they relate to your everyday life, and you will be able to think about and act on solutions and mitigation from the standpoint that you are one of the people in the problem.
授業計画
1. Guidance and Overview
2. Meat Eating 1
3. Meat Eating 2
Explain and discuss about the problems of carnivory, including the history of carnivory and livestock production, the beginning of animal welfare, problems in livestock production in modern society, vegan and insect eating.
4. Companion Animal1
5. Companion Animal2
Explain and discuss about the problems of companion animals, including human control of animals and the history of pets, the modern companion animal industry, pet loss, and exotic animals.
6. Hunting 1
7. Hunting 2
Explain and discuss about the problems of hunting, including the history of hunting, colonial rule and sport hunting, wildlife issues, and animal ethics.
8.field training
Catching and processing wild boars in the Ito campus.
